vehicles.name: 100i
vehicles.descriptionEn: Tour the universe with the perfect coupling of luxury and performance. The 100i features Origin Jumpworks' patented AIR fuel system, making it the most efficient and eco-friendly ship on the market. Capable of long distance flights that most ships of its size aren't equipped for, the 100i is perfect for solo pilots looking to turn heads without sacrificing functionality or reliability.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Reise mit der perfekten Kombination aus Luxus und Leistung durchs Universum. Die 100i verfügt über eine innovative hauseigene Technik, die sie zu einem der sparsamsten und umweltfreundlichsten Schiffe auf dem Markt macht. Im Gegensatz zu anderen Schiffen ihrer Größe ist die 100i für Langstreckenflüge ausgerüstet. Sie eignet sich perfekt für Solo-Piloten, die auffallen möchten, ohne dabei auf Funktionalität oder Zuverlässigkeit zu verzichten.

vehicles.name: 125a
vehicles.descriptionEn: Risks were meant to be taken, but why risk running out of fuel in the heat of battle? With the AIR fuel system, a souped-up weapons package, and all the luxury and refinement you've come to expect from Origin Jumpworks, the 125a has been designed for the discerning maverick.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Wer nicht wagt, der nicht gewinnt. Aber warum sollte man riskieren, mitten im Gefecht ohne Sprit dazustehen? Mit dem AIR-Treibstoffsystem, der verbesserten Waffenauswahl und all dem raffinierten Luxus, den man von Origin Jumpworks erwarten darf, ist die 125a die ideale Wahl für anspruchsvolle Freigeister.

vehicles.name: 135c
vehicles.descriptionEn: With a deceptive amount of storage space in its sleek, stylish frame, and Origin's patented AIR fuel system, the 135c model is the obvious choice for musicians, couriers, and anyone trying to get the party started. Get it there fast, and look good while you're doing it.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Mit seinem schnittigen, stilvollen Design, dem überraschend großen Laderaum und dem patentierten AIR-Treibstoffsystem von Origin ist das 135c-Modell die erste Wahl für Musiker, Kuriere und alle, die richtig Laune machen möchten. Schnell reingehen und dabei auch noch gut aussehen heißt die Devise.

vehicles.name: 300i
vehicles.descriptionEn: If you're going to travel the stars... why not do it in style? The 300i is Origin Jumpworks' premiere luxury spacecraft. It is a sleek, silver killer that sends as much of a message with its silhouette as it does with its particle cannons.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Wenn du schon zu den Sternen reist … warum dann nicht mit Stil? Die 300i ist das führende Luxusraumschiff von Origin Jumpworks. Dieser schnittige, silberfarbene Killer überzeugt mit seiner Silhouette wie mit seinen Partikelkanonen.

vehicles.name: 315p
vehicles.descriptionEn: Exploration is man's highest calling. Prepare to chart distant horizons with man's most sophisticated piece of technology, the Origin 315p. Featuring a more robust power plant and a custom scanning package, exclusively designed by Chimera Communications.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Erkundung ist das größte Ziel der Menschheit und die Origin 315p ist das fortschrittlichste technologische Meisterwerk, das je dafür gebaut wurde. Mit einer robusteren Energieanlage und einem maßgeschneiderten Scanpaket von Chimera Communications.

vehicles.name: 325a
vehicles.descriptionEn: Just because it's a rough galaxy doesn't mean you need to sacrifice your comfort: the 325a can come out on top in any dogfight. The 325a features an advanced weapon payload as well as a custom targeting system designed especially for the 325a by WillsOp.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Nur weil es in der Galaxie rau zugeht, musst du noch lange nicht auf Komfort verzichten: Die 325a ist in jedem Raumkampf obenauf. Ihre Ausstattung umfasst eine erweiterte Bewaffnung sowie ein maßgeschneidertes Zielsystem speziell für die 325a von WillsOp.

vehicles.name: 350r
vehicles.descriptionEn: Origin Jumpwork's 300 series is the ultimate fusion of elegance and astroengineering. Every component is individually calibrated to ensure your ship stays in perfect harmony. By far the fastest member of the family, the 350r refocus the 300's power and translates it into pure speed.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Die 300er-Serie von Origin Jumpworks ist die ultimative Verschmelzung von Eleganz und Raumfahrttechnik. Jede Komponente wird individuell kalibriert, um sicherzustellen, dass dein Schiff stets in perfekter Harmonie bleibt. Als mit Abstand schnellstes Mitglied der Familie konzentriert die 350r die Power der 300er neu und setzt sie in pure Geschwindigkeit um.

vehicles.name: 400i
vehicles.descriptionEn: To explore the stars is a most noble endeavor, and Origin Jumpworks has risen to the occasion in crafting the 400i high-performance pathfinder. With class-leading range, substantial defensive capabilities, and a factory-equipped scanning array, the 400i is ready to take on the harshest corners of the galaxy while maintaining the comfort and elegance Origin is known for.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Es ist ein edles Unterfangen, die Sterne zu erforschen. Origin Jumpworks hat dafür die 400i als ultimativen Hochleistungs-Fernspäher entwickelt. Mit der höchsten Reichweite der Klasse, umfangreichen Defensivoptionen und einem serienmäßigen Scansystem kann man sich in die gefährlichsten Gegenden der Galaxie wagen, ohne auf den Komfort und die Eleganz zu verzichten, die für Origin typisch sind.

vehicles.name: 600i
vehicles.descriptionEn: This multi-role luxury vessel from Origin Jumpworks features an exquisitely detailed hull design that balances performance and versatility in a sleek and timeless form. The 600i is designed with a cutting-edge modular technology, allowing you to customize your ship for your needs.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Dieses Mehrzweck-Luxusfahrzeug von Origin Jumpworks bietet ein exquisit ausgeführtes Rumpfdesign, das in schnittiger, zeitloser Form Leistung mit Vielseitigkeit vereint. Die 600i ist mit hochmoderner Modulartechnologie ausgestattet, mit der sie sich an jeden Bedarf anpassen lässt.

vehicles.name: 600i 2951 BIS
vehicles.descriptionEn: This multi-role luxury vessel from Origin Jumpworks features an exquisitely detailed hull design that balances performance and versatility in a sleek and timeless form. The 600i is designed with a cutting-edge modular technology, allowing you to customize your ship for your needs. To celebrate the 600i being voted a Best in Show finalist for 2951, this edition of the ship features a special blue and black livery already applied.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Dieses Mehrzweck-Luxusschiff von Origin Jumpworks bietet ein exquisit ausgeführtes Rumpfdesign, das Leistung und Vielseitigkeit in eleganter, zeitloser Form zusammenführt. Die 600i verfügt über hochmoderne Modulartechnologie, sodass sich das Schiff an jeden Bedarf anpassen lässt. Die 600i wurde 2951 zum „Best in Show“-Finalisten gewählt, und zur Feier wurde diese Edition des Schiffs mit einer speziellen schwarzblauen Lackierung versehen.

vehicles.name: 600i Touring
vehicles.descriptionEn: This multi-role luxury vessel from Origin Jumpworks features an exquisitely detailed hull design that balances performance and versatility in a sleek and timeless form. The 600i is designed with a cutting-edge modular technology, allowing you to customize your ship for your needs.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Dieses Mehrzweck-Luxusfahrzeug von Origin Jumpworks bietet ein exquisit ausgeführtes Rumpfdesign, das in schnittiger, zeitloser Form Leistung mit Vielseitigkeit vereint. Die 600i ist mit hochmoderner Modulartechnologie ausgestattet, mit der sie sich an jeden Bedarf anpassen lässt.

vehicles.name: 85X Limited
vehicles.descriptionEn: Elegantly styled and meticulously constructed, the 85X is a versatile and comprehensive away-vessel that features precision control in and out of atmosphere. Utilizing much of the same thruster technology as the 300 series, it has the power of a racer with the reliability of a touring ship. Whether descending down to the planet surface or taking in the sights of your system, this runabout continues Origin’s proud tradition of turning heads.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Die elegant gestaltete und sorgfältig konstruierte 85X ist ein vielseitiges, gut ausgestattetes Expeditionsschiff, das eine präzise Steuerung in und außerhalb der Atmosphäre ermöglicht. Dank der Triebwerkstechnologie der 300er-Serie hat sie die Kraft eines Rennschiffes bei der Zuverlässigkeit eines Reiseschiffs. Ob beim Landen auf der Planetenoberfläche oder beim Genießen der Sehenswürdigkeiten Ihres Systems – dieser Flitzer führt die stolze Tradition von Origin fort, echte Hingucker zu fertigen.

vehicles.name: 890 Jump
vehicles.descriptionEn: With an elegant, sleek exterior that belies its spacious interior, the 890 Jump is a true engineering marvel; crafted to impress from every angle by combining a unique, innovative design with the finest materials and the most advanced technology. The result is a vessel that is in a class all of its own, a masterpiece worthy of the name Origin.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Mit dem eleganten, schnittigen Äußeren, dem man den üppigen Platz im Inneren nicht ansieht, ist die 890 Jump ein technisches Meisterwerk. Sie beeindruckt von allen Seiten und kombiniert einzigartiges, innovatives Design mit den besten Materialien und der fortschrittlichsten Technologie. Das Ergebnis ist eine Klasse für sich – ein Meisterwerk, des Namens Origin würdig.

vehicles.name: A1 Spirit
vehicles.descriptionEn: Crusader Industries brings its usual commitment to excellence directly to the civilian market with the A1 Spirit, a mid-size multi-purpose starship equipped as a light bomber but packing enough versatility to tackle multiple roles and unpredictable jobs.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Crusader Industries bringt seine typische Vorzüglichkeit direkt auf den zivilen Markt mit der A1 Spirit, einem Mehrzweckraumschiff mittlerer Größe, das als leichter Bomber ausgestattet und dabei vielseitig genug ist, um verschiedene Rollen auszufüllen und unberechenbare Jobs zu erledigen.

vehicles.name: A2 Hercules Starlifter
vehicles.descriptionEn: The A2 Starlifter has been used to devastating effect in airborne assaults, search and rescue operations, and landing initiatives. With more than double the firepower of the M2, and a custom bomb bay capable of delivering a staggering payload, the A2 caters to anyone hauling massive amounts of cargo through potentially unfriendly skies.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Die A2 wurde schon mit verheerender Wirkung als Kanonenschiff bei Luftangriffen, Such- und Rettungsoptionen sowie bei Landeinitiativen eingesetzt. Mit mehr als doppelt so hoher Feuerkraft wie die M2 und einem speziell angefertigten Bombenschacht, der eine beeindruckende Ladung abwerfen kann, kann die A2 massive Mengen an Fracht durch potenziell feindliche Gebiete tragen.

vehicles.name: Apollo Medivac
vehicles.descriptionEn: Along with superior armor and dual missile racks, the 2948 Apollo Medivac model pays homage to the classic 2910 film, Astromedics: Back from the Brink, with livery that accurately recreates the headlining Kithara.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Along with superior armor and dual missile racks, the 2948 Apollo Medivac model pays homage to the classic 2910 film, Astromedics: Back from the Brink, with livery that accurately recreates the headlining Kithara.

vehicles.name: Apollo Triage
vehicles.descriptionEn: The legendary Apollo Triage from Roberts Space Industries is the gold standard in medevac and rapid emergency response vehicles. Updated to support regeneration technology, the Apollo has a long history providing critical aid to the Empire and beyond for well over two centuries.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Die legendäre Apollo Triage von Roberts Space Industries ist der Goldstandard für den zügigen Notdienst. Seit über zwei Jahrhunderten leistet sie im Imperium und darüber hinaus wichtige Hilfe und wurde nun überarbeitet, um auch Regenerationstechnologie zu unterstützen.

vehicles.name: Ares Star Fighter Inferno
vehicles.descriptionEn: Whether heading up a crew or hunting big ships solo, the Ares Inferno is a force to be reckoned with. This ballistic Gatling-equipped variant tears through gunship armor and turns smaller fighters to dust in seconds.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Ob als Captain einer Crew oder als Einzelkämpfer auf der Jagd nach großen Schiffen – Die Ares Inferno ist eine Kraft, mit der man rechnen muss. Diese mit ballistischer Gatling ausgerüstete Variante zerfetzt im Nu die Panzerung von Kampfschiffen und verwandelt kleinere Jäger in Staub.

vehicles.name: Ares Star Fighter Ion
vehicles.descriptionEn: Spark fear in the corridors of the most formidable gunships and frigates with the Ares Ion. This laser-equipped variant delivers extremely powerful shots to quickly disable the shields of even the biggest enemy vessels.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Die Ares Ion sorgt selbst an Bord der besten Kanonenschiffe und Fregatten für Panik. Diese laserbestückte Variante ist zu extrem kraftvollen Schüssen imstande, mit denen sich die Schilde mächtiger feindlicher Schiffe rasch deaktivieren lassen.

vehicles.name: Arrow
vehicles.descriptionEn: Unmatched design, blazing top speed, and ultra-responsive maneuverability make the Arrow the most agile scrapper in its class. With a robust weapons package that provides firepower to spare, this is truly the classic light fighter, updated for the next generation of combat.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Unvergleichliches Design, bemerkenswertes Spitzentempo und ultra-responsive Manövrierfähigkeit machen die Arrow zur wendigsten Kämpferin ihrer Klasse. Die robuste Waffenauswahl sorgt für ausreichend Feuerkraft. Ein klassischer leichter Jäger, bereit für die nächste Generation des Kampfs.

vehicles.name: Asgard
vehicles.descriptionEn: As the battles of today continue to grow in scale and complexity, Anvil Aerospace understands the impact a single vehicle can have on the outcome. Enter the Asgard. The next generation in ground vehicle transport, the Anvil Asgard features a quick-load ramp, a sizeable hold to securely store your assault vehicle of choice, and hefty array of armaments to ensure access to even the most combat-heavy of drop sites.
vehicles.descriptionDe: As the battles of today continue to grow in scale and complexity, Anvil Aerospace understands the impact a single vehicle can have on the outcome. Enter the Asgard. The next generation in ground vehicle transport, the Anvil Asgard features a quick-load ramp, a sizeable hold to securely store your assault vehicle of choice, and hefty array of armaments to ensure access to even the most combat-heavy of drop sites.

vehicles.name: Aurora Mk I CL
vehicles.descriptionEn: Customized for mercantile and trading excursions, the Aurora Clipper is the perfect vessel for aspiring entrepreneurs and seasoned traders alike. Swapping a smaller power plant and armor capabilities for an expanded cargo capacity, the Clipper ups the ante for personal merchant craft.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Die Aurora Clipper wurde speziell für Handelsmissionen entwickelt und eignet sich perfekt für angehende Unternehmer und erfahrene Händler zugleich. Durch die Nutzung einer kleineren Energieanlage und weniger Panzerung zugunsten von erweiterten Frachtkapazitäten setzt die Clipper neue Maßstäbe für private Handelsschiffe.

vehicles.name: Aurora Mk I ES
vehicles.descriptionEn: The Aurora is the modern day descendant of the Roberts Space Industries X-7 spacecraft which tested the very first jump engines. Utilitarian to a T, the Aurora is the perfect beginner's ship: what it lacks in style it makes up for in ample room for upgrade modules.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Die Aurora ist das moderne Nachfolgemodell des Raumschiffs X-7, das von Roberts Space Industries entwickelt wurde und die allerersten Sprungantriebe testete. Die bis ins kleinste Detail praktisch ausgerichtete Aurora ist das perfekte Schiff für Anfänger: Was ihr an Stil fehlt, macht sie mit ausreichend Platz für Upgrade-Module mehr als wett.

vehicles.name: Aurora Mk I LN
vehicles.descriptionEn: With a more robust shield generator and a pair of additional weapon hard points, the Legionnaire is a dedicated combat fighter, built to handle any obstacle the universe can throw at you.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Mit einem robusteren Schildgenerator und zwei zusätzlichen Waffenaufhängungen ausgestattet, ist die Legionnaire ein echter Jäger, der es mit allen Problemen aufnehmen kann, die das Universum so bietet.

vehicles.name: Aurora Mk I LX
vehicles.descriptionEn: Be proud of your roots with the brand-new Aurora Deluxe, built for the discerning pilot who never forgets where he or she came from. The LX features patent leather interior to guarantee comfort for those long stretches in the deep black.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Sei stolz auf deine Wurzeln und zeige dies auch mit der brandneuen Aurora Deluxe, die für anspruchsvolle Piloten gebaut wurde, die ihre Herkunft nicht vergessen. Die LX verfügt über eine Lederinnenausstattung, um möglichst großen Komfort auf den langen Strecken in der Schwärze des Alls zu garantieren.

vehicles.name: Aurora Mk I MR
vehicles.descriptionEn: Perhaps you're looking for something that offers carrying capacity but has combat capabilities too? The Aurora Marque comes with a pair of Behring-quality lasers and a high quality gun cooler system.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Du suchst nach einem Raumschiff, das sowohl Tragekapazitäten als auch Kampfausstattung bietet? Die Aurora Marque verfügt über zwei Behring-Laser und ein hochwertiges Waffenkühlsystem.

vehicles.name: Aurora Mk I SE
vehicles.descriptionEn: Integrating the best of what made the Aurora Mk I series so beloved by generations, this special edition strikes an impressive balance to allow pilots to tackle a wide array of tasks. With the Aurora Mk I SE parked in your hangar, this all-arounder is sure to become a daily flyer thanks to its ability to handle whatever life throws your way.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Integrating the best of what made the Aurora Mk I series so beloved by generations, this special edition strikes an impressive balance to allow pilots to tackle a wide array of tasks. With the Aurora Mk I SE parked in your hangar, this all-arounder is sure to become a daily flyer thanks to its ability to handle whatever life throws your way.

vehicles.name: Aurora Mk II
vehicles.descriptionEn: A new take of the classic ship, Roberts Space Industries has reimagined the tried-and-true Aurora from the struts up. Introducing the Aurora Mk II. Everything from the ship’s performance, usability, to its styling has been overhauled with a new generation of pilots in mind. Plus, this latest version introduces a new trick for the Aurora series – swappable modules. Rather than locking pilots into a single career path, these modules allow for straightforward operational specialization from the comfort of your hangar. Whether you’re a first-time shipowner, or a long-time pilot ready for an upgrade to your daily flyer, the Aurora Mk II is waiting for you.
vehicles.descriptionDe: A new take of the classic ship, Roberts Space Industries has reimagined the tried-and-true Aurora from the struts up. Introducing the Aurora Mk II. Everything from the ship’s performance, usability, to its styling has been overhauled with a new generation of pilots in mind. Plus, this latest version introduces a new trick for the Aurora series – swappable modules. Rather than locking pilots into a single career path, these modules allow for straightforward operational specialization from the comfort of your hangar. Whether you’re a first-time shipowner, or a long-time pilot ready for an upgrade to your daily flyer, the Aurora Mk II is waiting for you.

vehicles.name: Avenger Stalker
vehicles.descriptionEn: Initially designed as Aegis’ frontline carrier ship for the military, the Avenger Stalker took a different path, ultimately having a long and storied career as the standard patrol craft of the UEE Advocacy. Utilizing its cargo hold for prisoner transport, the Avenger features a sturdy, reliable hull and the capacity for larger-than-expected engine mounts.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Die Avenger Stalker wurde ursprünglich als Aegis’ militärisches Trägerschiff für den Fronteinsatz konzipiert, doch dann kam vieles anders, und heute blickt das Schiff auf eine lange Karriere als standardmäßiges Patrouillenschiff der UEE Advokatur zurück. Die Avenger nutzt ihren Frachtraum für Gefangenentransporte, verfügt über eine robuste und zuverlässige Schiffshülle und kann größere Triebwerke unterbringen, als man erwarten würde.

vehicles.name: Avenger Titan
vehicles.descriptionEn: Lacking the Prisoner Cells of the Stalker or the EMP Generator of the Warlock, the Titan’s hold is free to carry cargo. Couple that available space with the Avenger’s tried and true combat abilities and you’ve got a light cargo hauler that’s more than capable of handling itself in a fight.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Ohne die Arrestzellen der Stalker oder den EMP-Generator der Warlock bietet der Frachtraum der Titan reichlich Platz für Fracht. In Kombination mit den bewährten Kampfeigenschaften der Avenger, erhält man einen leichten Frachter, der sich im Kampf mehr als behaupten kann.

vehicles.name: Avenger Titan Renegade
vehicles.descriptionEn: Created as part of the ‘Masters of Flight’ series in conjunction with the flight-sim Arena Commander, the Renegade pays tribute to famed pilot Danny Solomon for his notable work with the Advocacy to bring justice to Bremen. This Avenger Titan comes equipped with a specialized dogfighting focused loadout and a custom special edition livery honoring this iconic ship.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Created as part of the ‘Masters of Flight’ series in conjunction with the flight-sim Arena Commander, the Renegade pays tribute to famed pilot Danny Solomon for his notable work with the Advocacy to bring justice to Bremen. This Avenger Titan comes equipped with a specialized dogfighting focused loadout and a custom special edition livery honoring this iconic ship.

vehicles.name: Avenger Warlock
vehicles.descriptionEn: The Avenger Warlock was built towards a single design philosophy: stop ships, don’t destroy them. Probably the closest to a non-lethal fighter, the Warlock is outfitted with a Behring REP-8 EMP Generator, capable of emitting a powerful electromagnetic wave to disable any electronics unfortunate enough to be within the blast radius.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Die Avenger Warlock wurde mit einem einzigen Ziel entwickelt: Schiffe aufhalten zu können, ohne sie dabei zu zerstören. Diese Eigenschaft und der eingebaute REP-8-EMP-Generator von Behring, der eine starke elektromagnetische Welle aussenden kann, die alle elektronischen Geräte im Explosionsradius außer Gefecht setzt, machen die Warlock wahrscheinlich zum Archetyp eines nicht tödlichen Jägers.

vehicles.name: Ballista
vehicles.descriptionEn: Keep your airspace clear of danger with the Anvil Ballista. Originally designed to defend outposts from Vanduul attacks, this mobile missile defense system packs a powerful loadout, allowing the Ballista to stand firm against any threat, whether it arrives by air or land.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Mit der Anvil Ballista lässt sich die Lufthoheit problemlos behaupten. Ursprünglich diente sie dazu, Außenposten gegen Vanduul-Angriffe zu verteidigen. Das mobile Raketenabwehrsystem bietet eine mächtige Ausrüstung, sodass die Ballista jeder Gefahr zu Lande und von oben standhält.

vehicles.name: Ballista Dunestalker
vehicles.descriptionEn: Keep your airspace clear of danger with the Anvil Ballista. Originally designed to defend outposts from Vanduul attacks, this mobile missile defense system packs a powerful loadout, allowing the Ballista to stand firm against any threat, whether it arrives by air or land. The Dunestalker variant features a naturalistic paint scheme ideal for blending into harsh landscapes.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Mit der Anvil Ballista lässt sich die Lufthoheit problemlos behaupten. Ursprünglich diente sie dazu, Außenposten gegen Vanduul-Angriffe zu verteidigen. Das mobile Raketenabwehrsystem bietet eine mächtige Ausrüstung, sodass die Ballista jeder Gefahr zu Lande und von oben standhält. Die Dunestalker-Variante bietet eine naturalistische Lackierung, die sich vollkommen in unwirtliche Landschaften einfügt.

vehicles.name: Ballista Snowblind
vehicles.descriptionEn: Keep your airspace clear of danger with the Anvil Ballista. Originally designed to defend outposts from Vanduul attacks, this mobile missile defense system packs a powerful loadout, allowing the Ballista to stand firm against any threat, whether it arrives by air or land. The Snowblind variant comes in a grey camouflage pattern to keep it concealed against rocky or lunar terrain.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Mit der Anvil Ballista lässt sich die Lufthoheit problemlos behaupten. Ursprünglich diente sie dazu, Außenposten gegen Vanduul-Angriffe zu verteidigen. Das mobile Raketenabwehrsystem bietet eine mächtige Ausrüstung, sodass die Ballista jeder Gefahr zu Lande und von oben standhält. Die Snowblind-Variante bietet ein graues Tarnmuster, das sich für Felsen- und Mondgelände eignet.

vehicles.name: Basher
vehicles.descriptionEn: A testament to making something out of nothing, the Basher comes together to form a beast to be reckoned with. The long development of this ship, due to Greycat's trial-and-error approach to mixing ship parts until they figured out the best combinations, goes to show the work put in to elevate this machine from the scraps it was built from.
vehicles.descriptionDe: A testament to making something out of nothing, the Basher comes together to form a beast to be reckoned with. The long development of this ship, due to Greycat's trial-and-error approach to mixing ship parts until they figured out the best combinations, goes to show the work put in to elevate this machine from the scraps it was built from.

vehicles.name: Blade
vehicles.descriptionEn: These light fighters, designation 'Blade', are often used by Vanduul as scouts and first wave assault crafts. They have also served well as skirmisher units due to their speed allowing them to chase down any ships attempting to flee the area. For some decades, United Empire of Earth aggressor squadrons have operated replica Blade fighters produced under exclusive contract by Esperia, Inc.
vehicles.descriptionDe: These light fighters, designation 'Blade', are often used by Vanduul as scouts and first wave assault crafts. They have also served well as skirmisher units due to their speed allowing them to chase down any ships attempting to flee the area. For some decades, United Empire of Earth aggressor squadrons have operated replica Blade fighters produced under exclusive contract by Esperia, Inc.

vehicles.name: Buccaneer
vehicles.descriptionEn: The Buccaneer has been designed from the ground up to fly and fight the way you live. No leather interiors or hyperpillows here: the Bucc is a scrapper designed to maneuver and fight above its weight class. This rough-and-tumble frontier fighter can be maintained in the worst of conditions in order to keep real, working space crews alive.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Die Buccaneer wurde von Grund auf entwickelt, so zu fliegen und zu kämpfen, wie du lebst. Keine Lederausstattung. Keine Hyperkissen. Die Bucc ist ein Raubein, das darauf ausgelegt ist, gegen Schiffe anzutreten, die über ihrer Gewichtsklasse liegen. Dieser auf das Wesentliche reduzierte Jäger lässt sich selbst unter den härtesten Bedingungen instand halten, um echte, hart arbeitende Weltraumbesatzungen am Leben zu halten.

vehicles.name: C1 Spirit
vehicles.descriptionEn: Crusader Industries brings its usual commitment to excellence directly to the civilian market with the C1 Spirit, a mid-size multi-purpose starship built for cargo transport and delivery but packing enough versatility to tackle multiple roles and unpredictable jobs.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Crusader Industries bringt seine typische Vorzüglichkeit direkt auf den zivilen Markt mit der C1 Spirit, einem Mehrzweckraumschiff mittlerer Größe für Transport und Lieferung von Frachten, das vielseitig genug ist, um verschiedene Rollen zu erfüllen und unberechenbare Jobs zu erledigen.

vehicles.name: C2 Hercules Starlifter
vehicles.descriptionEn: Utilizing the patented Hercules military-grade spaceframe and expanding cargo capacity, while sacrificing barely any firepower, the C2 has taken the private sector by storm. It has become the industry standard for racing teams, ship dealers and manufacturers, construction orgs, mining corporations, and even large-scale touring entertainment outfits.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Utilizing the patented Hercules military-grade spaceframe and expanding cargo capacity, while sacrificing barely any firepower, the C2 has taken the private sector by storm. It has become the industry standard for racing teams, ship dealers and manufacturers, construction orgs, mining corporations, and even large-scale touring entertainment outfits.

vehicles.name: C8 Pisces
vehicles.descriptionEn: With its compact frame, deft maneuverability, and seating for three, the C8 Pisces snub craft, included with every Carrack, is built by Anvil Aerospace for scouting ahead or exploring environments inaccessible to its larger carrier ship.
vehicles.descriptionDe: With its compact frame, deft maneuverability, and seating for three, the C8 Pisces snub craft, included with every Carrack, is built by Anvil Aerospace for scouting ahead or exploring environments inaccessible to its larger carrier ship.

vehicles.name: C8R Pisces Rescue
vehicles.descriptionEn: With the addition of an onboard Tier 3 Medical Bed, the C8R Pisces can treat minor injuries and keep a patient stable while transporting them to the safety of a larger ship, station, or nearby medical facility, making it an invaluable asset for short-range search and rescue.
vehicles.descriptionDe: With the addition of an onboard Tier 3 Medical Bed, the C8R Pisces can treat minor injuries and keep a patient stable while transporting them to the safety of a larger ship, station, or nearby medical facility, making it an invaluable asset for short-range search and rescue.

vehicles.name: C8X Pisces Expedition
vehicles.descriptionEn: Sporting more guns and a limited-edition livery, the C8X Pisces Expedition turns the stout snub into a perfectly viable standalone exploration vessel. With its compact frame, deft maneuverability, and seating for three, the Pisces Expedition is ready to take on its own adventures.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Sporting more guns and a limited-edition livery, the C8X Pisces Expedition turns the stout snub into a perfectly viable standalone exploration vessel. With its compact frame, deft maneuverability, and seating for three, the Pisces Expedition is ready to take on its own adventures.

vehicles.name: Carrack
vehicles.descriptionEn: Adventure calls and Anvil Aerospace answers with the Carrack. Built to endure extreme conditions in both space and atmosphere, this self-sustaining explorer has more than earned its long-standing status as the go-to pathfinder for both military and civilian service.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Das Abenteuer ruft, und Anvil Aerospace antwortet mit der Carrack. Auf extreme Bedingungen sowohl im Weltraum als auch in Atmosphären ausgelegt, hat sich dieses selbstversorgende Erkundungsschiff seinen traditionellen Status als Fernspäher der Wahl sowohl zu militärischen als auch zu zivilen Zwecken mehr als verdient.

vehicles.name: Carrack Expedition
vehicles.descriptionEn: Adventure calls and Anvil Aerospace answers with the Carrack. Built to endure extreme conditions in both space and atmosphere, this self-sustaining explorer has more than earned its long-standing status as the go-to pathfinder for both military and civilian service. The 'Expedition' edition features a special livery ideal for boldly traveling the stars.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Das Abenteuer ruft, und Anvil Aerospace antwortet mit der Carrack. Auf extreme Bedingungen sowohl im Weltraum als auch in Atmosphären ausgelegt, hat sich dieses selbstversorgende Erkundungsschiff seinen traditionellen Status als Fernspäher der Wahl sowohl zu militärischen als auch zu zivilen Zwecken mehr als verdient. Die Expedition-Version bietet eine Speziallackierung, die ideal für kühne Reisen zu den Sternen ist.

vehicles.name: Caterpillar
vehicles.descriptionEn: First introduced in 2871, Drake Interplanetary's Caterpillar has long proven to be a reliable, cost-effective multi-role vessel, capable of being outfitted for everything from mercantile operations to combat support. Long hailed as a hard-fought alternative to the ubiquitous Hull series, the Caterpillar is a freighter that doesn't skimp on weaponry or customization.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Die Caterpillar von Drake Interplanetary wurde 2871 eingeführt und hat sich seither als zuverlässiges, kostengünstiges Mehrzweckfahrzeug erwiesen, das sich für alles von Handelsoperationen bis zur Kampfunterstützung eignet. Lang als hart erkämpfte Alternative zur allgegenwärtigen Hull-Reihe gepriesen, ist die Caterpillar ein Frachter, der nicht mit Waffen oder individueller Ausstattung geizt.

vehicles.name: Caterpillar Pirate
vehicles.descriptionEn: First introduced in 2871, Drake Interplanetary's Caterpillar has long proven to be a reliable, cost-effective multi-role vessel, capable of being outfitted for everything from mercantile operations to combat support. Long hailed as a hard-fought alternative to the ubiquitous Hull series, the Caterpillar is a freighter that doesn't skimp on weaponry or customization. This model features a unique livery applied by the previous owners.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Die Caterpillar von Drake Interplanetary wurde 2871 eingeführt und hat sich seither als zuverlässiges, kostengünstiges Mehrzweckfahrzeug erwiesen, das sich für alles von Handelsoperationen bis zur Kampfunterstützung eignet. Lang als hart erkämpfte Alternative zur allgegenwärtigen Hull-Reihe gepriesen, ist die Caterpillar ein Frachter, der nicht mit Waffen oder individueller Ausstattung geizt. Dieses Modell verfügt über eine besondere Lackierung, die von den Vorbesitzern aufgebracht wurde.

vehicles.name: Centurion
vehicles.descriptionEn: Built on Anvil's popular Atlas Platform, the Centurion presents a tactical solution for short-range anti-aircraft operations. Thanks to the Centurion’s custom energy-based AA turret, your forces can establish ground superiority by assuring immediate threats from above are dealt with quickly and efficiently.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Das Centurion bietet auf Basis der beliebten Atlas-Plattform von Anvil eine taktische Lösung für Luftabwehroperationen auf kurze Distanz. Dank des individuellen energiebasierten Luftabwehrgeschützes kann jede unmittelbare Bedrohung aus der Luft schnell und effizient bekämpft und damit Bodenüberlegenheit erzielt werden.

vehicles.name: Clipper
vehicles.descriptionEn: If there’s one thing every captain needs to take to heart as they prepare to journey across the stars it’s “expect the unexpected.” With a cargo bay, medical facilities, and crafting capabilities, along with Drake’s practical design sensibility, the Clipper is the perfect all-arounder for any new spacefaring enterprise.
vehicles.descriptionDe: If there’s one thing every captain needs to take to heart as they prepare to journey across the stars it’s “expect the unexpected.” With a cargo bay, medical facilities, and crafting capabilities, along with Drake’s practical design sensibility, the Clipper is the perfect all-arounder for any new spacefaring enterprise.

vehicles.name: Constellation Andromeda
vehicles.descriptionEn: The Constellation Andromeda is a dependable multi-crew freighter that appeals to merchants across the empire thanks to its versatility. One of the most popular ships that RSI produces, the iconic Andromeda features a well-appointed cargo bay, a snub-fighter docking port, and a signature wrap-around bridge.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Die Constellation Andromeda ist ein Frachter für mehrere Personen und das beliebteste Schiff in der aktuellen Produktionsreihe von RSI. Constellations sind bei Schmugglern und Händlern gleichermaßen beliebt, weil sie modular und leistungsstark sind und einfach kultig aussehen.

vehicles.name: Constellation Aquila
vehicles.descriptionEn: Designed by RSI to traverse distant frontiers, the Constellation Aquila features a redesigned cockpit for maximum visibility, advanced sensors, and a P-52 snub craft and Ursa rover for planetary exploration. Discover for yourself why explorers the ‘verse over choose to captain the Aquila.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Designed by RSI to traverse distant frontiers, the Constellation Aquila features a redesigned cockpit for maximum visibility, advanced sensors, and a P-52 snub craft and Ursa rover for planetary exploration. Discover for yourself why explorers the ‘verse over choose to captain the Aquila.

vehicles.name: Constellation Phoenix
vehicles.descriptionEn: A dedicated luxury spacecraft for the discerning star captain. The Constellation Phoenix can be operated as an organization command ship and features a luxurious redesigned interior. Includes a hidden sensor-dampened area for your most precious cargo. The Phoenix comes with a Lynx rover and a Kruger P-72 Archimedes Fighter.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Ein luxuriöses Raumschiff für den anspruchsvollen Raumpiloten. Die Constellation Phoenix kann als Kommandoschiff einer Organisation genutzt werden und verfügt über eine luxuriöse Innenausstattung. Enthalten ist unter anderem ein verborgener, sensorgedämpfter Bereich für besonders wertvolle Fracht. Neben einem Lynx-Rover hat die Phoenix auch einen Jäger vom Typ Kruger P-72 Archimedes an Bord.

vehicles.name: Constellation Phoenix Emerald
vehicles.descriptionEn: Whether you are a discerning socialite or a freewheeling party animal, the Constellation Phoenix Emerald is your personal passport to entertainment. With a swank interior cabin designed specifically for revelry, and a limited edition "lucky" paint job, the Emerald is the perfect venue to sip a glass of Radegast Gold or throw back a green Sleeping Tiger Malt while hurtling luxuriously through the stars. Just be sure to bring a designated pilot.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Ob wählerische Prominenz oder unbekümmerte Feierbiester – die Constellation Phoenix Emerald ist für jeden der Inbegriff der Unterhaltung. Das ganz auf Feierlichkeiten abgestimmte Innendesign und die limitierte „Glücksbringer“-Lackierung machen die Emerald zum idealen Ort, um an einem Radegast Gold zu nippen oder einen grünen Sleeping Tiger Malt zu kippen, während man luxuriös zwischen den Sternen reist. Der Pilot sollte allerdings flugfähig bleiben.

vehicles.name: Constellation Taurus
vehicles.descriptionEn: Paired down to fully focus on hauling, the Taurus provides the most cargo space of any ship in RSI’s Constellation line-up. What it loses in versatility it more than makes up for in potential profits thanks to its tractor beams, a cargo release system for quick unloading, and a security hold reinforced with tech plating.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Genieße mit der Constellation Taurus das Multi-Crew-Abenteuer zu einem günstigen Preis. Sie ist ein reiner Frachter, der vollständig konfigurierbar ist – und das ohne Schnickschnack. Sie ist eine großartige Wahl für jeden, der zum ersten Mal mit Besatzung fliegt.

vehicles.name: Corsair
vehicles.descriptionEn: Heed the call of uncharted space and harness the spirit of exploration with the Drake Corsair. Utilizing a unique asymmetrical hull design, this versatile explorer can go wherever the winds of adventure may steer you.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Folge mit der Drake Corsair deinem Entdeckergeist und dem Ruf des unkartierten Raums. Dieser vielseitige Erkunder mit dem besonderen asymmetrischen Rumpfdesign gelangt an jeden Ort, an den die Winde des Abenteuers dich tragen mögen.

vehicles.name: CSV-SM
vehicles.descriptionEn: You got your plot of land, you’ve got the right construction materials, and now you’re ready to watch your dreams take shape. The ideal companion to the CSV-FM, the CSV Supply Model provides additional storage for all the resources required to build your next settlement.
vehicles.descriptionDe: You got your plot of land, you’ve got the right construction materials, and now you’re ready to watch your dreams take shape. The ideal companion to the CSV-FM, the CSV Supply Model provides additional storage for all the resources required to build your next settlement.

vehicles.name: Cutlass Black
vehicles.descriptionEn: Drake Interplanetary claims that the Cutlass Black is a low-cost, easy-to-maintain solution for local in-system militia units. The larger-than-average cargo hold, RIO seat and dedicated tractor mount are, the company literature insists, for facilitating search and rescue operations.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Drake Interplanetary behauptet, die Cutlass Black sei eine kostengünstige, leicht zu wartende Lösung für lokale Milizeinheiten im System. Der überdurchschnittlich große Frachtraum, der Abfangradarsitz und die spezielle Traktorhalterung sollen laut Unternehmen Such- und Rettungsaktionen erleichtern.

vehicles.name: Cutlass Blue
vehicles.descriptionEn: Sleek, mean, and royal. The Cutlass Blue adds missiles, a more aggressive engine, and Durasteel holding cells in the cargo bay to the standard model. The Cutlass Blue is the outworld militia standard ship of choice for patrols.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Elegant, mächtig und königlich. Die Cutlass Blue erweitert das Standardmodell um Raketen, ein aggressiveres Triebwerk und Durasteel-Zellen im Frachtraum. Sie ist das Standardschiff der Miliz für Patrouillen in der Außenwelt.

vehicles.name: Cutlass Red
vehicles.descriptionEn: The Cutlass Red converts the standard cargo hold to a well-equiped medical facility including an Autodoc. This starbound ambulance features the Nav-E7 Echo Transponder, a long range scanner, and a Secure Plus Docking Collar, making it ideal for search and rescue. This model also features a unique Red Crossbones skin.
vehicles.descriptionDe: The Cutlass Red converts the standard cargo hold to a well-equiped medical facility including an Autodoc. This starbound ambulance features the Nav-E7 Echo Transponder, a long range scanner, and a Secure Plus Docking Collar, making it ideal for search and rescue. This model also features a unique Red Crossbones skin.

vehicles.name: Cutlass Steel
vehicles.descriptionEn: With the Cutlass Steel, Drake Interplanetary has once again reinvented their classic design to create a next generation combat transport ship through the addition of dedicated jump seats and an expanded arsenal. It’s a dangerous ‘verse out there, and the Cutlass Steel is ready to cut a path through whatever stands in the way of you and your dedicated crew.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Mit der Cutlass Steel hat Drake Interplanetary sein klassisches Design ein weiteres Mal neu erfunden und um Notsitze und ein erweitertes Arsenal ergänzt, um ein Kampftransportschiff der nächsten Generation herzustellen. Das Universum ist gefährlich und die Cutlass Steel bereit, dir und deiner Crew einen Weg zu bahnen.

vehicles.name: Cutter
vehicles.descriptionEn: Designed for hard-working folks of all stripes, the Cutter packs 4 SCU of cargo room and plenty of wallop into a rough and tumble, compact frame. It's a ship that truly embodies the spirit of Drake: that no matter who you are or what you do, you can reach the stars.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Die Cutter wurde für hart arbeitende Leute aller Art entwickelt. Sie bietet 4 SFE Laderaum und jede Menge Power in einem kompakten, soliden Rahmen. Dieses Schiff verkörpert den Geist von Drake: Wer du auch bist und was du auch tust – du kannst die Sterne erreichen.

vehicles.name: Cutter Rambler
vehicles.descriptionEn: The brass at Drake heard what you had to say, and their answer was the Cutter Rambler. Building upon the original, the Rambler preserves a full 2 SCU of cargo room while adding in requested creature comforts and enough personal storage to make even the longest journey go by in a flash.
vehicles.descriptionDe: The brass at Drake heard what you had to say, and their answer was the Cutter Rambler. Building upon the original, the Rambler preserves a full 2 SCU of cargo room while adding in requested creature comforts and enough personal storage to make even the longest journey go by in a flash.

vehicles.name: Cutter Scout
vehicles.descriptionEn: Pairing down the rough and tumble, compact frame of the Cutter to the bare essentials, Drake took an already impressive ship and transformed it into the ideal scouting vessel. Featuring improved radar and scanning capabilities paired with more power and cooling, the Cutter Scout is ready to fly ahead of the pack.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Pairing down the rough and tumble, compact frame of the Cutter to the bare essentials, Drake took an already impressive ship and transformed it into the ideal scouting vessel. Featuring improved radar and scanning capabilities paired with more power and cooling, the Cutter Scout is ready to fly ahead of the pack.

vehicles.name: Cyclone
vehicles.descriptionEn: With a potent combination of speed, maneuverability, and rugged durability, the Cyclone is a perfect choice for local deliveries and transport between planetside homesteads and outposts.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Die Cyclone ist dank ihrer potenten Kombination aus Tempo, Manövrierfähigkeit und Zähigkeit ideal für lokale Lieferungen und Transporte zwischen planetarischen Stützpunkten und Außenposten.

vehicles.name: Cyclone AA
vehicles.descriptionEn: A battlefield equalizer, the Cyclone AA comes equipped with a surface-to-air missile and countermeasure package to provide cover for ground troops against airborne targets.
vehicles.descriptionDe: A battlefield equalizer, the Cyclone AA comes equipped with a surface-to-air missile and countermeasure package to provide cover for ground troops against airborne targets.

vehicles.name: Cyclone MT
vehicles.descriptionEn: Following the success of the initial release of the Cyclone, Tumbril has taken your feedback and expanded their popular line of tactical vehicles with the all new Cyclone MT. Outfitted with a combination gun and missile turret, this module offers increased combat options in the field.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Following the success of the initial release of the Cyclone, Tumbril has taken your feedback and expanded their popular line of tactical vehicles with the all new Cyclone MT. Outfitted with a combination gun and missile turret, this module offers increased combat options in the field.

vehicles.name: Cyclone RC
vehicles.descriptionEn: For those who like to push the limits of speed, the Cyclone RC features a modified intake system to allow for controlled bursts of speed as well as tools to customize handling.
vehicles.descriptionDe: For those who like to push the limits of speed, the Cyclone RC features a modified intake system to allow for controlled bursts of speed as well as tools to customize handling.

vehicles.name: Cyclone RN
vehicles.descriptionEn: Stay mobile and aware with the Cyclone RN. This light reconnaissance vehicle is the perfect solution for scouting runs, providing fast and detailed scans of terrain as well as beacon placement.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Stay mobile and aware with the Cyclone RN. This light reconnaissance vehicle is the perfect solution for scouting runs, providing fast and detailed scans of terrain as well as beacon placement.

vehicles.name: Cyclone TR
vehicles.descriptionEn: Designed for militia and security use, the Cyclone TR module features upgraded armor and a single Human-operated turret capable of mounting a Size 1 weapon and a responsive 360° field of fire.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Designed for militia and security use, the Cyclone TR module features upgraded armor and a single Human-operated turret capable of mounting a Size 1 weapon and a responsive 360° field of fire.

vehicles.name: Defender
vehicles.descriptionEn: Meet the Banu Defender, a multi-crew fighter whose patchwork design highlights technology from a variety of species. Featuring modest accommodations for its crew and easy access to components, the Defender gets its name from the role it serves: the first line of defense against enemy attacks. That's why the Defender makes the ideal companion to the Merchantman: one to do the heavy hauling and the other to perform the deadly dogfighting.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Die Defender ist ein Banu-Jäger für eine mehrköpfige Crew, in deren Patchwork-Design die Technologien zahlreicher Spezies eingegangen sind. Die Crew ist schlicht untergebracht, der Zugriff auf die Komponenten erfolgt unkompliziert. Die Defender verdankt ihren Namen ihrer Rolle als erste Verteidigungslinie bei gegnerischen Angriffen. Das macht sie zur idealen Begleitung für die Merchantman: Eine tut die schwere Arbeit, die andere versieht den Raumkampf.

vehicles.name: Dragonfly
vehicles.descriptionEn: The Drake Dragonfly is the perfect snub ship for anyone looking to live on the edge. With nothing separating the pilot from the dangers of space, the Dragonfly is as much an adventure as a ship! Dual-mode conversion allows the Dragonfly to operate on the ground or in space, and a rear-facing second seat means you can even take a passenger!
vehicles.descriptionDe: The Drake Dragonfly is the perfect snub ship for anyone looking to live on the edge. With nothing separating the pilot from the dangers of space, the Dragonfly is as much an adventure as a ship! Dual-mode conversion allows the Dragonfly to operate on the ground or in space, and a rear-facing second seat means you can even take a passenger!

vehicles.name: Dragonfly Yellowjacket
vehicles.descriptionEn: The Drake Dragonfly is the perfect snub ship for anyone looking to live on the edge. With nothing separating the pilot from the dangers of space, the Dragonfly is as much an adventure as a ship! Dual-mode conversion allows the Dragonfly to operate on the ground or in space, and a rear-facing second seat means you can even take a passenger! This model features a custom Yellowjacket paintjob.
vehicles.descriptionDe: The Drake Dragonfly is the perfect snub ship for anyone looking to live on the edge. With nothing separating the pilot from the dangers of space, the Dragonfly is as much an adventure as a ship! Dual-mode conversion allows the Dragonfly to operate on the ground or in space, and a rear-facing second seat means you can even take a passenger! This model features a custom Yellowjacket paintjob.

vehicles.name: Eclipse
vehicles.descriptionEn: The Aegis Eclipse is a bomber designed to get in and strike before it's ever even spotted. After extensive service with the UEE, this high-tech military equipment made its civilian market debut in 2947.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Der Bomber Aegis Eclipse ist darauf ausgelegt zuzuschlagen, ehe er überhaupt entdeckt wird. Nach langem Dienst beim UEE hatte diese Hightech-Militärausrüstung 2947 ihr Debüt auf dem zivilen Markt.

vehicles.name: F7A Hornet Mk I
vehicles.descriptionEn: The UEE Navy's premier carrier-based fighter craft, the F7A Hornet Mk I is the front-line attack ship for military combat missions. While not outfitted for long range runs, the Hornet can take her share of hits and dish out a powerful response.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Als erster trägerbasierter Jäger der UEE Navy ist die F7A bei militärischen Kampfmissionen das Angriffsschiff, das an vorderster Front eingesetzt wird. Auch wenn sich die Hornet nicht für Langstreckenflüge eignet, kann sie ordentlich einstecken … und bietet eine durchgängig mächtige Erwiderung.

vehicles.name: F7A Hornet Mk II
vehicles.descriptionEn: Ushering in a new age of space superiority, Anvil Aerospace has re-engineered the celebrated Hornet for the next generation of fighter combat.  Purpose built for the UEE Navy, the F7A Hornet Mk II maintains the spirit of the original while incorporating even more powerful offensive capabilities.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Ushering in a new age of space superiority, Anvil Aerospace has re-engineered the celebrated Hornet for the next generation of fighter combat.  Purpose built for the UEE Navy, the F7A Hornet Mk II maintains the spirit of the original while incorporating even more powerful offensive capabilities.

vehicles.name: F7C Hornet Mk I
vehicles.descriptionEn: To the enemy, it is a weapon never to be underestimated. To allies, it's a savior. The F7C Hornet Mk I is the same dependable and resilient multi-purpose fighter that has become the face of the UEE Navy. The F7C is the foundation to build on and meet whatever requirements you have in mind.
vehicles.descriptionDe: To the enemy, it is a weapon never to be underestimated. To allies, it's a savior. The F7C Hornet Mk I is the same dependable and resilient multi-purpose fighter that has become the face of the UEE Navy. The F7C is the foundation to build on and meet whatever requirements you have in mind.

vehicles.name: F7C Hornet Mk II
vehicles.descriptionEn: Straight from the front lines to your personal hangar, the re-engineered F7C Hornet Mk II takes the latest battlefield upgrades and makes them available to private pilots across the empire. The fighter features an improved power system utilized by an overhauled weapon and missile package
vehicles.descriptionDe: Straight from the front lines to your personal hangar, the re-engineered F7C Hornet Mk II takes the latest battlefield upgrades and makes them available to private pilots across the empire. The fighter features an improved power system utilized by an overhauled weapon and missile package

vehicles.name: F7C Hornet Wildfire Mk I
vehicles.descriptionEn: Created as part of the ‘Masters of Flight’ series in conjunction with the flight-sim Arena Commander, the Wildfire pays tribute to famed pilot Aria Reilly for her distinguished service with the legendary Squadron 42. This F7C Hornet Mk I comes equipped with her own personally selected loadout preferences and a custom special edition livery honoring her iconic ship.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Created as part of the ‘Masters of Flight’ series in conjunction with the flight-sim Arena Commander, the Wildfire pays tribute to famed pilot Aria Reilly for her distinguished service with the legendary Squadron 42. This F7C Hornet Mk I comes equipped with her own personally selected loadout preferences and a custom special edition livery honoring her iconic ship.

vehicles.name: F7C-M Hornet Heartseeker Mk I
vehicles.descriptionEn: Designed for pilots whose true love is the pulse-pounding thrill of a harrowing dogfight, the limited-edition F7C-M Heartseeker Mk I is 'the one' for true combat die-hards. Loaded with top-of-the-line components and outfitted with four imposing Behring laser cannons, this fierce eradicator hones the legendary combat proficiency of the Super Hornet to give you the ultimate edge in space combat.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Für Piloten entworfen, deren wahre Liebe die atemlose Aufregung eines harten Raumkampfs ist. Die limitierte F7C-M Heartseeker ist die erste Wahl wahrer Draufgänger. Mit vorzüglichen Komponenten und vier imposanten Behring-Laserkanonen ausgestattet, verfeinert dieser gnadenlose Auslöscher die legendäre Kampfbeschlagenheit der Super Hornet noch und verleiht den ultimativen Vorteil im Raumkampf.

vehicles.name: F7C-M Hornet Heartseeker Mk II
vehicles.descriptionEn: When the F7C-M Super Hornet got upgraded to the Mk II, there was no doubt in the Anvil Aerospace’s mind that they would be giving the very special Heartseeker edition the same treatment. With its robust weapon package designed for pilots whose true love is the thrill of a harrowing dogfight, the limited-edition F7C-M Heartseeker Mk II is set to become the favorite ship for an all-new generation of true combat die-hards.
vehicles.descriptionDe: When the F7C-M Super Hornet got upgraded to the Mk II, there was no doubt in the Anvil Aerospace’s mind that they would be giving the very special Heartseeker edition the same treatment. With its robust weapon package designed for pilots whose true love is the thrill of a harrowing dogfight, the limited-edition F7C-M Heartseeker Mk II is set to become the favorite ship for an all-new generation of true combat die-hards.

vehicles.name: F7C-M Super Hornet Mk I
vehicles.descriptionEn: The closest to the Military load-out as is legally possible for a Civilian model, the F7C-M Super Hornet Mk I reattaches the ball turret and offers near milspec parts under the hood. Proving that two heads are better than one, a second seat has been added to split the logistic and combat duty, making the Super Hornet a truly terrifying mark to engage.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Die F7C-M Super Hornet kommt der militärischen Ausrüstung so nahe, wie es für zivile Modelle gesetzlich möglich ist. Sie verfügt über ein Kugelgeschütz und hat Teile unter der Haube, die fast schon Militärspezifikationen entsprechen. Da zwei Köpfe mehr sehen als einer, wurde ein zweiter Sitz eingebaut, um Logistik- und Kampfaufgaben aufzuteilen, was die Super Hornet zu einem ernst zu nehmenden Gegner macht.

vehicles.name: F7C-M Super Hornet Mk II
vehicles.descriptionEn: Refining their renowned military-class superiority fighter with the most up-to-date technology, Anvil Aerospace has crafted the F7C-M Super Hornet Mk II,  retaining the second seat and ball turret that made the original a truly terrifying mark to engage.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Refining their renowned military-class superiority fighter with the most up-to-date technology, Anvil Aerospace has crafted the F7C-M Super Hornet Mk II,  retaining the second seat and ball turret that made the original a truly terrifying mark to engage.

vehicles.name: F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
vehicles.descriptionEn: If the Ghost is made to hide, the Tracker is made to seek. The F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I boasts an advanced radar suite making it ideal for deep-space explorers who require depth and accuracy in their scan packages. Local militia and larger merc units will also repurpose Trackers to act as mobile C&C ships for their squadrons.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Während die Ghost gebaut wurde, um ungesehen zu bleiben, dient die Tracker hingegen zum Aufspüren. Die F7C-R Tracker verfügt über eine moderne Radarausstattung, wodurch sie ideal ist für Erforschende des Weltraums, die große Tiefe und Genauigkeit bei ihren Scans benötigen. Örtliche Milizen und größere Handelseinheiten können die Tracker zudem zu mobilen Kommandoschiffen für ihre Staffeln umfunktionieren.

vehicles.name: F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk II
vehicles.descriptionEn: When seeking the next great frontier, who better to trust than a next-generation pathfinder? The F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk II boasts an overhauled radar suite ideal for deep-space explorers who require depth and accuracy in their scan packages.
vehicles.descriptionDe: When seeking the next great frontier, who better to trust than a next-generation pathfinder? The F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk II boasts an overhauled radar suite ideal for deep-space explorers who require depth and accuracy in their scan packages.

vehicles.name: F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk I
vehicles.descriptionEn: Through a combination of low-emission drives, low-draw weapons, and Void Armor technology capable of diffusing scans, the F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk I is built for the pilot who wants to keep a low profile. The Ghost is capable of slipping past the most ardent of observers to accomplish whatever goal you need to accomplish. Don't worry, we won't ask.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Durch die Kombination aus emissionsarmen Antrieben, Waffen mit niedrigem Energieverbrauch und Void-Panzerung-Technologie eignet sich die F7C-S Ghost für Piloten, die unentdeckt bleiben wollen. Die Ghost kommt ungesehen an den wachsamsten Beobachtern vorbei und ermöglicht dir so, deine Ziele zu verfolgen. Keine Sorge, wir stellen keine Fragen.

vehicles.name: F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk II
vehicles.descriptionEn: When approaching the Mk II redesign of the F7C-S Hornet Ghost, the engineers at Anvil Aerospace wanted to preserve what pilots loved about the low-emission drives, low-draw weapons, and Void Armor technology of the original, but refine them to an even higher level of performance for a whole new era of stealth operations.
vehicles.descriptionDe: When approaching the Mk II redesign of the F7C-S Hornet Ghost, the engineers at Anvil Aerospace wanted to preserve what pilots loved about the low-emission drives, low-draw weapons, and Void Armor technology of the original, but refine them to an even higher level of performance for a whole new era of stealth operations.

vehicles.name: F8A Lightning
vehicles.descriptionEn: Few vehicles employed by the proud men and women who serve in our Empire’s Navy inspire the awe of the legendary F8 Lightning. A force to be reckoned with, the F8 has secured Humanity’s freedom from numerous threats at home and abroad countless times.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Nur wenige Fahrzeuge, die von den stolzen Männern und Frauen der UEE Navy benutzt werden, sind so ehrfurchtgebietend wie die legendäre F8 Lightning. Mit der Macht dieses Jägers muss man rechnen – die F8 hat die Freiheit der Menschen schon zahllose Male vor Gefahren zu Hause und anderswo gerettet.

vehicles.name: F8C Lightning
vehicles.descriptionEn: Few vehicles employed by the proud men and women who serve in our Empire's Navy inspire the awe of the legendary F8 Lightning. A force to be reckoned with, the F8 has secured Humanity's freedom from numerous threats at home and abroad countless times. Now, that same next generation space superiority fighter is available to become a part of your personal fleet with the Anvil F8C civilian variant.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Few vehicles employed by the proud men and women who serve in our Empire's Navy inspire the awe of the legendary F8 Lightning. A force to be reckoned with, the F8 has secured Humanity's freedom from numerous threats at home and abroad countless times. Now, that same next generation space superiority fighter is available to become a part of your personal fleet with the Anvil F8C civilian variant.

vehicles.name: F8C Lightning Executive Edition
vehicles.descriptionEn: Always ready to improve upon near-perfection, Anvil has coordinated with the Chairman's Club to create this stunning work of flying art, the F8C Lighting Executive Edition. The hull has been beautifully accentuated with a unique premium livery, while in the cockpit you'll find sumptuous gold and metallic detailing, a fitting crown for this king of heavy fighters.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Always ready to improve upon near-perfection, Anvil has coordinated with the Chairman's Club to create this stunning work of flying art, the F8C Lighting Executive Edition. The hull has been beautifully accentuated with a unique premium livery, while in the cockpit you'll find sumptuous gold and metallic detailing, a fitting crown for this king of heavy fighters.

vehicles.name: Fury
vehicles.descriptionEn: Featuring best-in-class maneuverability and fully integrated, cutting-edge Xi’an tech, the next-generation Fury snub fighter from Mirai uses its four halo-mounted size 2 laser repeaters to redefine short-range space combat.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Der zukunftsweisende Annexjäger Fury von Mirai mit der besten Manövrierfähigkeit seiner Klasse und voll integrierter hochmoderner Xi'an-Technologie nutzt seine vier kreisförmig montierten Laser-Repetierer der Größe 4, um den Raumkampf auf kurze Distanz neu zu definieren.

vehicles.name: Fury LX
vehicles.descriptionEn: Featuring best-in-class maneuverability and fully integrated, cutting-edge Xi’an tech, the next-generation Fury LX racing ship from Mirai switches out the lithe ship’s offensive capabilities to make room for additional maneuvering thrusters perfect for getting across the finish line.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Featuring best-in-class maneuverability and fully integrated, cutting-edge Xi’an tech, the next-generation Fury LX racing ship from Mirai switches out the lithe ship’s offensive capabilities to make room for additional maneuvering thrusters perfect for getting across the finish line.

vehicles.name: Fury MX
vehicles.descriptionEn: Featuring best-in-class maneuverability and fully integrated, cutting-edge Xi’an tech, the next-generation Fury MX snub bomber from Mirai uses its twenty halo-mounted missiles to devastate targets during short-range space combat.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Der zukunftsweisende Annexbomber Fury MX von Mirai mit der besten Manövrierfähigkeit seiner Klasse und voll integrierter hochmoderner Xi'an-Technologie nutzt seine zwanzig kreisförmig montierten Raketen, um Ziele im Raumkampf auf kurze Distanz zu pulverisieren.

vehicles.name: Gladiator
vehicles.descriptionEn: The civilian model of the Gladiator appeals to those that want to explore the ‘verse with a bit of added security. Supporting a maximum of two, the Gladiator is perfectly equipped to explore and fight with or without a wingman. The Civilian model allows pilots to choose between an extra cargo hold or a bomb bay.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Das zivile Modell der Gladiator eignet sich für alle, die das Versum mit zusätzlicher Sicherheit erkunden wollen. Die Gladiator ist auf maximal zwei Personen ausgelegt und ist perfekt für Erkundungen und den Kampf mit oder ohne Wingman. Beim zivilen Modell können Piloten zwischen einem zusätzlichen Frachtraum oder einem Bombenschacht wählen.

vehicles.name: Gladius
vehicles.descriptionEn: The Gladius is an older design which has been updated over the years to keep up with modern technology. In military circles, the Gladius is beloved for its performance and its simplicity. A fast, light fighter with a laser-focus on dogfighting, the Gladius is an ideal interceptor or escort ship.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Bei der Gladius handelt es sich um ein älteres Design, das im Laufe der Jahre überarbeitet wurde, um mit der modernen Technologie mithalten zu können. In Militärkreisen ist die Gladius für ihre Leistung und Schlichtheit beliebt. Als schneller, leichter Jäger mit Laserfokus für den Raumkampf ist die Gladius ein ideales Abfang- oder Eskortschiff.

vehicles.name: Gladius Pirate
vehicles.descriptionEn: Aegis Gladius Pirate
vehicles.descriptionDe: Aegis Gladius Pirate

vehicles.name: Gladius Valiant
vehicles.descriptionEn: Created as part of the ‘Masters of Flight’ series in conjunction with the flight-sim Arena Commander, the Valiant pays tribute to famed defense pilot Condi Hillard for being the first Human on record to defeat a Vanduul in combat. This Gladius comes equipped with a specialized dogfighting focused loadout and a custom special edition livery honoring her iconic ship.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Als Teil der „Masters of Flight“-Serie in Verbindung mit dem Flugsimulator Arena Commander zollt die Valiant der berühmten Pilotin Condi Hillard Tribut, der erste Mensch, der je einen Vanduul im Kampf besiegt hat. Diese Gladius beinhaltet spezielle Ausrüstung für Raumkämpfe und hat eine besondere Lackierung, die zu Ehren ihres ikonischen Schiffs entwickelt wurde.

vehicles.name: Glaive
vehicles.descriptionEn: The Glaive is a symmetrical version of the Scythe. Generally flown by Vanduul with more combat experience, they are better armed and have two huge blades/wings as opposed to one on the standard Scythe.
vehicles.descriptionDe: The Glaive is a symmetrical version of the Scythe. Generally flown by Vanduul with more combat experience, they are better armed and have two huge blades/wings as opposed to one on the standard Scythe.

vehicles.name: Golem
vehicles.descriptionEn: With the Golem, Drake designed the ideal ship for those interested in starting a mining career. The ship features a bespoke mining laser and the capacity to carry 32 SCU of valuable resources. In classic Drake fashion, the Golem is a purpose-built ship that prioritizes function over frills.
vehicles.descriptionDe: With the Golem, Drake designed the ideal ship for those interested in starting a mining career. The ship features a bespoke mining laser and the capacity to carry 32 SCU of valuable resources. In classic Drake fashion, the Golem is a purpose-built ship that prioritizes function over frills.

vehicles.name: Golem OX
vehicles.descriptionEn: With the Golem OX, Drake has transformed the dependable workhorse into the ideal cargo ship for hauling supplies and equipment. Made for pilots who prefer function over frills, the OX doubles the capacity of the original with room for 64 SCU and features a tractor beam to make cargo transfers smooth as silk.
vehicles.descriptionDe: With the Golem OX, Drake has transformed the dependable workhorse into the ideal cargo ship for hauling supplies and equipment. Made for pilots who prefer function over frills, the OX doubles the capacity of the original with room for 64 SCU and features a tractor beam to make cargo transfers smooth as silk.

vehicles.name: Guardian
vehicles.descriptionEn: Taking the adage that the best defense is a good offense, Mirai engineers have brought their expertise in performance and maneuverability to the Guardian long range fighter.  Fly circles around your opponents with the Mirai Guardian while establishing your space superiority.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Taking the adage that the best defense is a good offense, Mirai engineers have brought their expertise in performance and maneuverability to the Guardian long range fighter.  Fly circles around your opponents with the Mirai Guardian while establishing your space superiority.

vehicles.name: Guardian MX
vehicles.descriptionEn: Taking the framework of the Guardian fighter and adding even more offensive options, the Mirai Guardian MX packs additional firepower and armor ideal for overwhelming opponents. While not as nimble as the base Guardian, this heavy fighter is still more agile than many other ships in its class.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Taking the framework of the Guardian fighter and adding even more offensive options, the Mirai Guardian MX packs additional firepower and armor ideal for overwhelming opponents. While not as nimble as the base Guardian, this heavy fighter is still more agile than many other ships in its class.

vehicles.name: Guardian QI
vehicles.descriptionEn: Taking the adage that the best defense is a good offense, Mirai engineers have brought their expertise in performance and maneuverability to the Guardian long range fighter.  Fly circles around your opponents with the Mirai Guardian while establishing your space superiority.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Taking the adage that the best defense is a good offense, Mirai engineers have brought their expertise in performance and maneuverability to the Guardian long range fighter.  Fly circles around your opponents with the Mirai Guardian while establishing your space superiority.

vehicles.name: Hammerhead
vehicles.descriptionEn: A fast patrol ship with multiple turrets designed to combat fighters, the Hammerhead is equally suited to support larger capital ships in a fleet or act as a flagship for fighter groups.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Die Hammerhead ist als schnelles Patrouillenschiff mit mehreren Geschützen auf den Kampf gegen Jäger ausgelegt, wodurch sie sowohl Großkampschiffe in einer Flotte unterstützen als auch ihrerseits Jägergruppen als Flaggschiff dienen kann.

vehicles.name: Hammerhead 2949 Best In Show Edition
vehicles.descriptionEn: A fast patrol ship with multiple turrets designed to combat fighters, the Hammerhead is equally suited to support larger capital ships in a fleet or act as a flagship for fighter groups.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Die Hammerhead ist als schnelles Patrouillenschiff mit mehreren Geschützen auf den Kampf gegen Jäger ausgelegt, wodurch sie sowohl Großkampschiffe in einer Flotte unterstützen als auch ihrerseits Jägergruppen als Flaggschiff dienen kann.

vehicles.name: Hawk
vehicles.descriptionEn: A small, light fighter with an emphasis on weaponry, the Hawk boasts an impressive arsenal of lethal and non-lethal weapons, making it a perfect ship for independent bounty hunters or local security looking for a little more punch.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Als kleiner leichter Jäger mit Schwerpunkt auf Bewaffnung weist die Hawk ein beeindruckendes Arsenal tödlicher und nicht tödlicher Waffen auf – das ideale Schiff für unabhängige Kopfgeldjäger und lokale Sicherheitseinheiten, die etwas mehr Eindruck hinterlassen möchten.

vehicles.name: Herald
vehicles.descriptionEn: The Drake Herald is a small, armored ship designed to safely get information from Point A to Point B. Featuring a powerful central engine (for high speed transit and generating the power needed for effective data encryption/containment), advanced encryption software and an armored computer core, the Herald is unique among personal spacecraft in that it is designed to be easily ‘cleaned’ when in danger of capture.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Die Drake Herald ist ein kleines gepanzertes Schiff, das dazu gedacht ist, Informationen sicher von A nach B zu bringen. Mit ihrem leistungsstarken Zentralantrieb (für Hochgeschwindigkeitstransporte und ausreichend Energie zur effektiven Verschlüsselung und Isolierung von Daten), hoch entwickelter Verschlüsselungssoftware und einem gepanzerten Computerkern ist die Herald einzigartig unter den privaten Raumschiffen. Sie ist zudem so konzipiert, dass sie im Falle einer drohenden Gefangennahme leicht „gesäubert“ werden kann.

vehicles.name: HoverQuad
vehicles.descriptionEn: Designed as a companion ground vehicle for the Nomad, the HoverQuad's sleek angular frame utilizes four grav-lev pads for maximum maneuverability, making it the perfect transport across all kinds of surfaces.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Das HoverQuad wurde als Begleit-Landfahrzeug für die Nomad entworfen. Der schnittige eckige Rahmen nutzt vier Gravlev-Pads, um die Manövrierfähigkeit zu maximieren und das HoverQuad für alle Oberflächen zu optimieren.

vehicles.name: Hurricane
vehicles.descriptionEn: Big things do come in small packages: the Hurricane is a fighting spacecraft that packs a deadly punch into a slight fuselage. The spacecraft compensates for its lack of creature comforts with its powerful armament: six guns capable of blasting their way through nearly anything. Hurricane pilots have yet to find an enemy shield they can't knock down.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Klein, aber oho: Die Hurricane ist ein Jäger, dessen schlankem Rumpf man seine Tödlichkeit nicht ansieht. Den Mangel an Komfort kompensiert die Hurricane mit ihrer mächtigen Bewaffnung: Sechs Kanonen, die sich durch praktisch alles hindurchschießen können. Ihre Piloten haben noch keinen gegnerischen Schild gefunden, den sie nicht pulverisieren konnten.

vehicles.name: Idris-M
vehicles.descriptionEn: Larger than a bomber but smaller than a ship-of-the-line, frigates occupy an interesting space in the pantheon of Naval warships. While they lack the heavy armor and the capital weaponry of a cruiser, the UEE Navy prizes its frigates as they are maneuverable and can be adapted for use in a wide-range of combat scenarios.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Larger than a bomber but smaller than a ship-of-the-line, frigates occupy an interesting space in the pantheon of Naval warships. While they lack the heavy armor and the capital weaponry of a cruiser, the UEE Navy prizes its frigates as they are maneuverable and can be adapted for use in a wide-range of combat scenarios.

vehicles.name: Idris-P
vehicles.descriptionEn: A mark two 'peacekeeper' variant developed for the UEE patrol services, the Idris-P strips the standard ship's ship-to-ship gun and spinal mount in favor of additional cargo capacity and superior speed.
vehicles.descriptionDe: A mark two 'peacekeeper' variant developed for the UEE patrol services, the Idris-P strips the standard ship's ship-to-ship gun and spinal mount in favor of additional cargo capacity and superior speed.

vehicles.name: Intrepid
vehicles.descriptionEn: For those eager to meet their future head on, the renowned ship engineers at Crusader Industries proudly present the Intrepid. A bold ship ready to tackle any number of jobs and conquer numerous challenges, the Intrepid features efficient cargo space and comfortable living quarters to make the most of your solo journey across the stars.
vehicles.descriptionDe: For those eager to meet their future head on, the renowned ship engineers at Crusader Industries proudly present the Intrepid. A bold ship ready to tackle any number of jobs and conquer numerous challenges, the Intrepid features efficient cargo space and comfortable living quarters to make the most of your solo journey across the stars.

vehicles.name: Ironclad
vehicles.descriptionEn: The universe has steadily grown more dangerous, and simply trying to earn a living has become a potentially lethal affair. That’s why Drake built the hardiest freighter to fly the shipping lanes armed with an intimidating array of turrets, a generous cargo hold, and a convenient tractor beam.
vehicles.descriptionDe: The universe has steadily grown more dangerous, and simply trying to earn a living has become a potentially lethal affair. That’s why Drake built the hardiest freighter to fly the shipping lanes armed with an intimidating array of turrets, a generous cargo hold, and a convenient tractor beam.

vehicles.name: Ironclad Assault
vehicles.descriptionEn: When the special delivery you have to make is a full-blown incursion, you need the Drake Ironclad Assault. Not only can it fit multiple ground vehicles into its hold, it has turrets along its underside to clear the way for landing, and even a fabrication bay for emergency repairs.
vehicles.descriptionDe: When the special delivery you have to make is a full-blown incursion, you need the Drake Ironclad Assault. Not only can it fit multiple ground vehicles into its hold, it has turrets along its underside to clear the way for landing, and even a fabrication bay for emergency repairs.

vehicles.name: Javelin
vehicles.descriptionEn: Designed for use by the UEE military, the Javelin is a massive, modular capital ship that can be appropriated for entrepreneurial use. With a detailed interior, plenty of modular room options, and a high crew capacity, the Javelin is a ship that has made a name for itself in a variety of roles.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Die Javelin wurde für den Einsatz durch das UEE-Militär entwickelt. Sie ist ein gewaltiges, modulares Großkampfschiff, das auch für kommerzielle Zwecke eingesetzt werden kann. Dank ihrer umfassenden Innenausstattung, zahlreichen modularen Raumoptionen und einer hohen Besatzungskapazität hat sich die Javelin in den verschiedensten Rollen einen Namen gemacht.

vehicles.name: Khartu-al
vehicles.descriptionEn: The Xi'an Aopoa corporation manufactures an export model of the Qhire Khartu, the Khartu-al, for sale to human civilians as a dedicated scout/explorer. The export model features the same Xi'an maneuvering rig, but control surfaces modified for Human use and a more limited armament.
vehicles.descriptionDe: Mit der Khartu-al produziert der Aopoa-Konzern der Xi'an eine für den Export bestimmte Variante der Qhire Khartu, die speziell für den Einsatz als Aufklärer und Erkunder entwickelt wurde und sich an menschliche Zivilisten richtet. Diese Exportvariante verwendet zwar die gleiche Steueranlage wie das Original, die Bedienelemente wurden jedoch an die Bedürfnisse von Menschen angepasst und die Bewaffnung begrenzt.

vehicles.name: L-21 Wolf
